neighbours.label: later digits of a comma-grouped quantity (a price, count or measurement like 4,750 or 25,600)
fire: The stadium seats about 62,450 fans on a busy match day.
A night at the resort costs between 7,850 yen and 14,200 yen.
The new sensor can shoot at up to ISO 51,200 in the dark.
The factory shipped 18,375 bicycles last year.
The well pumps roughly 3,640 liters of water every hour.
Tickets sold out after 24,980 people bought them online.
The used car has 87,320 miles on it but runs well.
The library added 5,715 new books to its shelves this year.
quiet: The stadium is at 1200 Park Avenue in ZIP code 62450.
Call the resort at 555-0185 to book a room for the night.
The new sensor has model number 51200 printed on its side.
The factory's order number for last year's shipment was 18375.
The well is listed as site 3640 on the county's water map.
Your ticket confirmation code is 24980, so keep it safe.
The used car's license plate reads 87320, issued in Ohio.
The library book has call number 5715 on its spine.

notes: Both poles fire on digits; - pole examples are quantities (prices, ISO values, toxicity values), + pole examples are identifiers (ZIP codes, page and article numbers). Probes on quantities 0.08-0.29, ZIP/page/phone numbers 0.01-0.04, so the median may miss 0.20.
